source.oembed_title: Different grip variations! Neutral vs supinated vs pronated grip. Neutral grip is the close grip. It will mostly bias your lats. ( single arm db row with a neutral grip, neutral grip lat pull down, neutral grip kneeling iliac pull down, neutral grip hammer rope curls, neutral grip db biceps curls, etc. ) Supinated grip is an under hand grip. The palms face you. ( supinated grip pull ups, supinated grip seated row, supinated grip biceps curls, etc. ) Pronated grip is an over hand grip. The palms face away from the body. ( chest supported row with a pronated grip, pronated grip pull ups, pronated grip barbell bent over row, etc. ) This is what a lot of you guys get confused with so I thought I’d make it short and sweet and hopefully help you with understanding the difference between each grip :) Need help with your training?! Sign up for my app ❤️  #anakaticfitness #fitness #upperbody

reviewer_checklist: Watch the whole video once before writing anything down.
Enumerate occurrences in chronological order, including repeats and both sides; repeats are separate occurrences even when the name matches.
For every occurrence set demonstrated.count to a number ONLY if continuous evidence shows every counted cycle. Otherwise leave 'unknown'.
Write acceptable_canonical_ids before you see any model output.
Record t0/t1 as the boundary you would accept plus uncertainty_s, not a point you had to guess.
Mark any claim you cannot resolve from the source as unresolvable rather than choosing the likely answer.
List, separately, (a) the exercises actually DEMONSTRATED in the 16 s and (b) the exercises merely NAMED in the caption. Only (a) are occurrences.
No ASR track was published, so any spoken content is unrecorded. If she does speak, note it: the has_speech label in SET.json is a guess from the absence of a track.
$exercises: Empty on purpose. The caption's exercise names are definitions, not a prescription, and pre-filling them would build the very hallucination this case exists to catch.
